d={'a':1000}
for key in ('a','a'): d[key]=d.get(key,0)+1
copy=d.copy();other=dict(d)
value=d['a']
print(value,copy['a'] is value,other['a'] is value,list(d.values())[0] is value)
for key in ('a',): d[key]=d.get(key,0)+1
print(value,copy['a'],d['a'],value is d['a'])

d={'a':1000,'b':2000,'c':3000}
for key in ('a','b','c'): d[key]=d.get(key,0)+1
del d['a']
print(list(d.items()))
d['x']=None;d['y']=False;d['z']='value'
print(list(d.items()))
old=d['b'];d['b']=None
print(old,d.pop('c'),d.setdefault('b',9),list(d.items()))

d={'a':1000}
for key in ('a','a'): d[key]=d.get(key,0)+1
for i in range(20): d[str(i)]=i
copy=d.copy()
print(d['a'],copy['a'] is d['a'],len(d))
d.clear()
print(copy['a'],len(d))
